title: kbjob.py submit records the placement decision in the job, and status shows where and as whom it runs and which level decided
goal: kbjob.py submit asks kj_place for the decision before it queues and keeps it in the job record as placement {executor, identity, fallback, fallback_after_s, budget_cap_usd, decided_by, reason}; status prints it; a decision that cannot be had queues the job for the workstation with the reason; a resubmit of a live job keeps the first decision

run:
import sys,os,json,time,tempfile,subprocess,threading,http.server
class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    seen=[]; out={}
    def do_POST(s):
        n=int(s.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0); H.seen.append((s.path,json.loads(s.rfile.read(n) or b"{}")))
        b=json.dumps(H.out).encode(); s.send_response(200); s.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(b))); s.end_headers(); s.wfile.write(b)
    def log_message(s,*a): pass
srv=http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1",0),H); threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever,daemon=True).start()
OPA=f"http://127.0.0.1:{srv.server_port}"
dec=lambda **k: {"result":dict({"executor":"workstation","identity":"none","fallback":None,"fallback_after_s":0,"budget_cap_usd":None,"decided_by":"default"},**k)}
d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); env=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(d,"c.sqlite"))
kj=lambda *x,e=None: subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kbjob.py",*x],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300,env=e or env)
H.out=dec(executor="server",identity="group-bot",decided_by="group:corp/ops")
j=json.loads(kj("submit","check","--name","backlog-check","--no-ensure","--opa",OPA).stdout)["job"]
s=json.loads(kj("status",j).stdout)["placement"]
j2=json.loads(kj("submit","check","--name","tests-changed","--no-ensure","--opa","http://127.0.0.1:9").stdout)["job"]
s2=json.loads(kj("status",j2).stdout)["placement"]
assert s["executor"]=="server" and s["identity"]=="group-bot" and s["decided_by"]=="group:corp/ops", s
assert s2["executor"]=="workstation" and s2["reason"], s2
